title: Strategies for quantum computing molecular energies using the unitary coupled cluster ansatz
problem_summary: Studies VQE with the unitary coupled cluster (UCC) ansatz, introduces circuit-depth-reduction strategies for UCC implementation, and proposes an analytical energy-gradient method that reduces gradient-estimation sampling cost by orders of magnitude versus numerical gradients.

components.family_or_name: unitary coupled cluster (UCC), with proposed circuit-depth-reduction strategies

components.notes: Analytical gradient method reduces sampling cost for gradient estimation by orders of magnitude vs. numerical gradients.

workflow_composition_notes: UCC ansatz combined with an analytical-gradient-based classical optimizer, aimed at reducing both circuit depth and optimization sampling cost relative to a naive UCC-VQE implementation.
